import gc, hashlib, importlib.util, json, math, pathlib
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('history',root/'scientific/transient-v67/analyze.py')
history=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(history)
specs=json.loads((root/'scientific/resolved-v68/specifications.json').read_bytes())
source='4d28113802de70f2624f3d5146f5e8f22508103e6ae8f255575d2ea62d935631'
data={}; hashes={}
def curve(state):
 a,b=state['lightMass'],state['heavyMass']
 return [0.]+[math.fsum(b[:i])-math.fsum(a[:i]) for i in range(1,len(a)+1)]
for row in specs:
 path=pathlib.Path('/work/home/resolved68-campaign')/(row['id']+'.json')
 with path.open('rb') as stream:hashes[row['id']]=hashlib.file_digest(stream,'sha256').hexdigest()
 with path.open() as stream:packet=json.load(stream)
 assert packet['sourceSHA256']==source and len(packet['cases'])==1
 case=packet['cases'][0];assert case['failure'] is None and len(case['steps'])==case['requestedSteps']==row['steps']
 states=[case['initialState']]+[s['result']['state'] for s in case['steps']]
 reduced=[{key:list(s[key]) for key in ('lightMass','heavyMass')} for s in states]
 n=len(reduced[0]['lightMass'])
 for s in reduced:
  for key in ('lightMass','heavyMass'):
   assert len(s[key])==n and all(math.isfinite(v) and v>=0 for v in s[key])
   assert abs(math.fsum(s[key])-1)<=512*math.ulp(1.)*n
 data[row['id']]={'q':[r*r for r in case['setup']['electrical']['radialEdgesM']],
  'states':reduced,'times':[0.]+[math.fsum(s['dtS'] for s in case['steps'][:i]) for i in range(1,len(case['steps'])+1)]}
 data[row['id']]['curves']=[curve(s) for s in reduced]
 del packet,case,states,reduced;gc.collect()
anchor=data[specs[0]['id']]; comparisons=[]
for row in specs[1:]:
 a=data[row['id']];b=anchor;axis=row['id'].split('-')[0]
 weights=history.overlap(a['q'],b['q'])
 signal=max(abs(v) for p in (a,b) for d in p['curves'] for v in d)
 errors=[];mapped=[]
 for ia,time in enumerate(a['times']):
  indices=[i for i,value in enumerate(b['times']) if history.close(time,value)]
  assert len(indices)==1;ib=indices[0]
  restricted={key:history.project_inventory(b['states'][ib][key],weights) for key in ('lightMass','heavyMass')}
  d=curve(restricted);mapped.append(d)
  for i,(coarse,fine) in enumerate(zip(a['curves'][ia],d)):
   errors.append({'absoluteError':abs(coarse-fine),'timeS':time,'qM2':a['q'][i],'coarseD':coarse,'restrictedFineD':fine})
 worst=max(errors,key=lambda r:r['absoluteError'])
 comparisons.append({'axis':axis,'coarseID':row['id'],'fineID':specs[0]['id'],'error':worst['absoluteError'],'signal':signal,
  'relativeError':history.ratio(worst['absoluteError'],signal),'worst':worst,
  'sharedInitialAndAcceptedTimes':len(a['times']),'fineOnlyTimesNotCompared':len(b['times'])-len(a['times']),
  'finalCoarseQ':a['q'],'finalCoarseD':a['curves'][-1],'finalRestrictedFineD':mapped[-1],
  'finalFineQ':b['q'],'finalFineD':b['curves'][-1]})
result={'sourceSHA256':source,'originalPacketsSHA256':hashes,'comparisons':comparisons,
 'definition':'D=CDF_heavy-CDF_light; E=max shared-time error after conservative inventory restriction; S=max abs(D) over both complete native histories. No positive scale floor.',
 'scope':'Additional signal-relative diagnostic, not a new or replacement acceptance gate. Global integrated separation only; no local enrichment, collection or experimental accuracy claim.',
 'zeroSignalInterpretation':'E=S=0 has zero raw error but does not qualify a developed separation signal.'}
with pathlib.Path('/work/home/resolved68-separation-diagnostic.json').open('x') as stream:json.dump(result,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
print(json.dumps([{k:c[k] for k in ('axis','error','signal','relativeError','worst')} for c in comparisons],indent=2))
